coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Associate, Product & Solution Design position at KPMG. My background combines software development, systems integration, requirements gathering, and client support, with responsibility for connecting operational needs to working software. As a Manager at DSTax Technologies, I serve as a technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform. The Digital Office’s emphasis on understanding business needs and partnering with technical teams to deliver practical solutions closely aligns with that experience.

At DSTax Technologies, I supported integration implementations from requirements gathering and setup through troubleshooting and go-live. I also managed internal development projects and client-coordinated work, sharing updates, reporting status, and responding to questions and requests. Leading the platform’s transition from Version 1 to Version 2 and improving its UI/UX gave me experience with both technical delivery and the user-facing aspects of a business application. Creating client guides and knowledge-base articles complemented that work by explaining the platform to the people using it. At Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global), I evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that made facility information available to employees and customers. I also managed SharePoint sites and data, designed data-input forms to improve accessibility and reduce errors, and initiated web automations that reduced manual database maintenance. These efforts connected information access, workflow improvement, and technology selection to operational needs.

I would welcome the opportunity to bring this implementation perspective to KPMG’s Product & Solution Design team. The role’s connection between stakeholder discovery, evolving requirements, and buildable digital solutions offers a clear extension of my work translating business needs into practical technical outcomes. Thank you for considering my application; I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss how my experience could support the LRMC Digital product portfolio.
Sincerely,
Kyle M. Anderson
reviewNotes: Emphasized requirements gathering, client coordination, UI/UX improvements, documentation, technology selection, and workflow automation. The master supports related technical experience since 2020 but does not establish five years specifically in product or UX design. Wireframes, user journeys, interactive prototypes, discovery workshop facilitation, Figma, Miro, Power Platform, Lovable, Microsoft Copilot, and formal Agile or human-centered design practices are not documented. Listed AI tools do not establish AI-assisted prototyping experience. U.S. work authorization and sponsorship eligibility are unspecified.

jobDescription.title: Senior Associate, Product & Solution Design
jobDescription.description: KPMG is seeking a Senior Associate Product & Solution Design to join the Digital Office within its Legal, Risk Management and Compliance organization. The role develops and iterates solution concepts, user journeys, workflows, wireframes and prototypes; facilitates stakeholder discovery; and partners with technical teams to deliver practical, buildable digital solutions. The posting is within Business Support Services. KPMG provides audit, tax and advisory services and describes a culture supporting individual development, inclusion, innovative excellence and community involvement.
responsibilities: Develop wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes to visualize and validate solution concepts, creating rapid prototypes using AI-assisted design and development tools such as Lovable and similar platforms.

Iterate designs and prototypes based on stakeholder feedback and evolving requirements while communicating solution concepts and user experiences through clear visual storytelling and design artifacts.

Participate in client discovery sessions to understand business needs, user pain points, workflows, and desired outcomes; help stakeholders refine and articulate ideas, requirements, and opportunities that may initially be loosely defined.
Translate business needs into user journeys, workflows, and solution concepts while identifying appropriate technologies, tools, and capabilities to address business challenges.

Partner with developers, AI/agent developers, data resources, and solution architects to ensure solutions are practical and buildable, documenting key workflows, functionality, requirements, and design decisions to support development efforts.

Help distinguish near-term requirements from future enhancements and evolving capabilities, contributing to reusable design patterns, standards, and practices across the LRMC Digital product portfolio.
Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment.
qualifications: Minimum five years of recent experience in product design, UX/UI design, digital solution design, business analysis, product management, or related discipline.

Bachelor's degree in Product Design, User Experience Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, or a related field, or five years equivalent professional experience.

Experience facilitating stakeholder discovery sessions, workshops, or requirements gathering activities, with demonstrated ability to translate business needs into user journeys, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and digital solution concepts.

Prior experience creating and iterating prototypes using modern design and prototyping tools, with experience in AI-assisted design or development platforms such as Lovable, Microsoft Copilot, or similar technologies.

Understanding of modern web applications, AI-enabled solutions, workflow automation, data visualization, and enterprise technology platforms, along with ability to collaborate effectively with developers, architects, product managers, and other technical resources.

Strong visual communication, presentation, facilitation, storytelling, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities with a user-centered design mindset; ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments and rapidly iterate from concept through prototype; experience with tools such as Figma, Miro, Power Platform, or similar design and collaboration platforms preferred; familiarity with Agile, product development, or human-centered design practices preferred.

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa).
